meta.name: description
meta.content: The University of Lethbridge is one of Canada’s top-ranked universities and leading research institutions. Alberta’s Destination University, the U of L attracts more than 8,700 undergraduate and graduate students from around the world to our campuses in Lethbridge and Calgary each year. We offer more than 150 undergraduate and 60 graduate programs in seven Faculties and Schools: Arts & Science, Education, Fine Arts, Health Sciences, Liberal Education, Graduate Studies and the Dhillon School of Business.

div.p: Located in the city of Lethbridge, the main ULethbridge Campus combines breathtaking natural beauty with cutting edge learning and research facilities. All undergraduate and graduate students at the main Campus have access to the exceptional academic programs, work-integrated learning, career experiences and support network they need to succeed.

div.class: entity entity-paragraphs-item paragraphs-item-basic-content col-md-7 col-sm-12 col-xs-12
entity entity-paragraphs-item paragraphs-item-card col-md-5 col-sm-12 col-xs-12 card-full

div.p: In Calgary, ULethbridge offers flexible undergraduate and graduate programs, offering evening, weekend, online and blended delivery options for all types of students. With business-, health- and technology-focused programs, work-integrated learning and a variety of support, ULethbridge in Calgary is where students upgrade their current credentials and careers, or pivot into new opportunities.

p.span: Strong, swift and enduring — the spirit of the pronghorn is legendary, and it lives within us all.
We are home to one of Canada’s most significant and diverse art collections.We also host fine arts events year round.

div.style: margin-left: calc(-50vw + 50%); margin-right: calc(-50vw + 50%); background-color: transparent;

div.class: entity entity-paragraphs-item paragraphs-item-basic-content col-md-8 col-sm-8 col-xs-12

div.p: Founded in 1967, on traditional Blackfoot land, the University of Lethbridge is home to 8,000 undergraduate and graduate students from around the world. With campuses in Lethbridge and Calgary, we are one of Canada's leading research institutions. Our Blackfoot name, gifted to us by Elder Bruce Wolf Child, is Iniskim, meaning Sacred Buffalo Stone.

div.class: entity entity-paragraphs-item paragraphs-item-card col-md-4 col-sm-4 remove-card-borders col-xs-12 card-full

div.style: margin-left: calc(-50vw + 50%); margin-right: calc(-50vw + 50%); background-color: transparent;

div.class: entity entity-paragraphs-item paragraphs-item-basic-content col-md-12 col-sm-12 col-xs-12

div.p: The University is located on traditional Blackfoot Confederacy territory. We honour the Blackfoot people and their traditional ways of knowing in caring for this land, as well as all Indigenous Peoples who have helped shape and continue to strengthen our University community.
